summary: Tiered bases and turret heads implement server-authoritative energy, recycler, damage, loot and concealment addon rules; Fake Drops restores the legacy fixed-profile FakePlayer loot context without persistent victim tags.

authoritative_state: TurretBaseBlockEntity owns addon inventory, energy generation, fuel consumption and recycler rolls.
TurretHeadBlockEntity snapshots combat addon context when it fires.
TurretDamageSource carries immutable per-hit context and, for Fake Drops levels 0-3, a server-scoped fixed-profile FakePlayer causing entity into the vanilla death-loot pipeline.
TurretHeadBlockState carries the derived concealed flag.

fields: Base addon levels remain derived from the stable 13-slot inventory payload.
Projectiles persist source base position, amp level, fake-drops level and suppress-loot snapshot.
Concealed state is derived and is not duplicated in BlockEntity NBT.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: All addon mechanics run without client classes; concealment uses a vanilla BlockState property.

generated: Turret blockstates contain concealed false and true variants backed by the existing models.

budgets.scope: One reactor inventory or loot-deleter lookup
budgets.measurement: Count the six Direction values visited by adjacent attachment or expander scans.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

criteria.statement: A Solar Panel adds exactly 10 FE during clear daytime with sky visibility and adds no FE after the sky is obstructed.
criteria.observation: The server fixture gains exactly 10 FE on the clear-sky tick, then its stored energy remains unchanged on the obstructed-sky tick.

criteria.statement: The reactor prefers redstone blocks, enforces strict free-capacity boundaries, consumes one selected fuel item and bypasses external receive-rate limits.
criteria.observation: Boundary vectors select block above 14400 FE free, dust at 14400 FE, and none below dust capacity; a real cycle consumes one block and stores exactly the block yield.

criteria.statement: Neither energy addon stacks with duplicate copies.
criteria.observation: Neither energy addon stacks with duplicate copies.

steps: Operate a tier-five base with each energy and combat addon in survival.
Observe fuel, ammunition, energy, damage and drops across several volleys.
Remove a Loot Deleter after a projectile launches and before it kills its target.
manual_checks.expected: Server-owned resources remain atomic and the projectile keeps its launch-time loot snapshot.

steps: Let a turret idle for 40 ticks, then move a legal target into range.
Inspect blockstate transitions with the debug screen.
manual_checks.expected: The concealed property toggles correctly; final retract/deploy geometry remains a documented later-phase item.

non_goals: Target priorities, team and pet policy, multi-target selection or warning behavior.
Final addon geometry, turret BER models or concealment animation.
Universal emulation of third-party player-only loot predicates.
Changing the openmodularturrets mod id, Java package or registry ids.
